question: Which among the following states hosted the Track Asia Cup 2022 Cycling Tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kerala hosted the **Track Asia Cup 2022 Cycling Tournament.**
 
• The **Track Asia Cup** is an **international cycling tournament** that features events like **sprint, endurance, team pursuit, keirin, and team sprint.**
 
• Kerala hosted the tournament at the** Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium** in the state capital,** Thiruvananthapuram,** from **13th to 16th October 2022.**
 
• **Maharashtra, Karnataka, and West Bengal** did not host the** Track Asia Cup 2022 Cycling Tournament.**
 
• The Track Asia Cup is an important event for cyclists from Asia and other parts of the world, as it provides them with a platform to** showcase their skills** and compete at the **highest level.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Maharashtra** is a state in western India that has hosted several sporting events, including the** Indian Premier League (IPL)** and the** Indian Super League (ISL)** in **cricket and football,** respectively.
 
• **Karnataka** is a state in** southern India** that is known for its** rich cultural heritage** and **IT industry.**
 
 
• It has hosted events like the **Indian Badminton League **and the **Pro Kabaddi League** in the past.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal** is a state in **eastern India** that has a strong sporting culture.
 
 
• It has hosted major events like the **FIFA U-17 World Cup **and the **Kolkata Marathon** in recent years.
